questions.question: Which imaginary line at 0° latitude divides the Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
options: The Equator
The Prime Meridian
The legend or key
Latitude and longitude

title: Economic Activities Around Us
section: NCERT Class 6 · Exploring Society: India and Beyond

questions.question: What is an economic activity?
options: A primary activity
A person or organisation that makes goods or provides services.
A setting or system where buyers and sellers exchange goods or services.
An activity involved in producing, distributing or using goods and services to meet needs and wants.
questions.explanation: Economic activities connect resources, work, goods, services and people's choices.

questions.question: What are goods in economic life?
options: Physical items that people can use or consume.
The secondary sector
A person who uses or buys a good or service.
An activity involved in producing, distributing or using goods and services to meet needs and wants.
questions.explanation: Goods can be produced, bought, sold, exchanged or used to meet needs.

questions.question: What is a service?
options: Physical items that people can use or consume.
Work or an activity done for someone, rather than a physical item itself.
The tertiary sector
Needs are essential for basic well-being; wants are additional desires that vary.
questions.explanation: Services meet needs through actions, skills or assistance.

options: A setting or system where buyers and sellers exchange goods or services.
Work or an activity done for someone, rather than a physical item itself.
A primary activity
A person or organisation that makes goods or provides services.
questions.explanation: Primary activities include agriculture, fishing, forestry and extraction of minerals.

questions.question: Which sector transforms raw materials into goods or builds structures?
options: A person who uses or buys a good or service.
An activity involved in producing, distributing or using goods and services to meet needs and wants.
A primary activity

Needs are essential for basic well-being; wants are additional desires that vary.
Physical items that people can use or consume.
The secondary sector
questions.explanation: The tertiary sector provides services to individuals, businesses or communities.

Work or an activity done for someone, rather than a physical item itself.
questions.explanation: Producers organise work and resources to supply goods or services.
